envelope.description: isModelCallFailure recognises a failed call by type or by the start of the provider's own message

body.title: isModelCallFailure recognises a failed call by type or by the start of the provider's own message
body.summary: src/analyze/context/model-failure.ts: true for a ModelCallFailedError, or for a message that BEGINS (after the retry helper's prefix) with a CLI provider's failure wording or 'Model call failed: '. The Ollama and socket texts are no longer matched anywhere inside a message. All seven consumers (classifier, planner, summariser, aggregator, synthesizer, decomposer, context driver) are reached by the same change. Grounding: today the CLI wordings (CLI_FAILURE_TEXTS) are already matched only at the start of the message (src/analyze/context/model-failure.ts:75-77; the list CLI_FAILURE_TEXTS is at :35) and stay as they are; only the Ollama/socket texts, matched anywhere today (:81-83), move to the type and the 'Model call failed: ' start.
acceptanceChecks: A validation message quoting 'ECONNREFUSED', 'Model not found', 'EPIPE' or 'fetch failed' without ' text=' is not a failed call.
A ModelCallFailedError, bare and behind the retry helper's prefix, is a failed call; a plain 'structured-output: ... attempts: Model call failed: ...' message is too.
Each consumer family, on a stand-in Ollama socket failure, still reports the model as unavailable, not a shape failure.
